title: The Support Team Debate · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: At a small company called Bright Tools, the support team met on Monday. The manager, Ms. Chen, wanted to discuss automation. 'We need to decide how to use new software to help our customers,' she said. 'Some tasks are slow, and we want to answer questions faster.' The team had eight people. They all listened carefully. Tom, a senior agent, raised his hand. 'I think we should use a chatbot to answer simple questions,' he said. 'Customers can get help at night. The chatbot is designed to give quick answers. But we must keep the human team for difficult problems.' Other people nodded. 'We need to train the chatbot to understand common questions,' Ms. Chen said. 'That takes time.' Lily disagreed. 'I enjoy talking to customers,' she said. 'A chatbot cannot show empathy. People feel happy when they speak to a real person. We should not replace people with machines.' She looked worried.
prompt:
Part 1
Do you use any apps or tools at work or school?
What simple task do you want a machine to do for you?
Do you enjoy talking to people or using machines?
Is it good to use chatbots for customer help?

Part 2
Describe a time when you used a new tool or app. You should say: what the tool was; why you used it; how you felt about it; and explain if you would use it again.

Part 3
How can technology help people at work?
Do you think machines will replace people in some jobs?
What problems can new tools cause?
Should companies train workers to use new software?
